name: Nathaniel Ingersoll Bowditch
bio: Nathaniel Ingersoll Bowditch (1805–1861) was a Boston man of business and antiquarian, the son of the navigator Nathaniel Bowditch and author of Suffolk Surnames (1857).
Edmund Clarence Stedman included his short poem “A World Beyond” in An American Anthology (1900).

poems.title: A World Beyond
poems.author: Nathaniel Ingersoll Bowditch
poems.text:
Science long watched the realms of space,
A planet’s devious path to trace:
Convinced of heaven’s harmonious law,
“A world beyond” Leverrier saw.

Thus when he views earth’s sins and woes,
With a like faith the Christian knows
There is a world beyond, to prove
God’s perfect wisdom, power, and love.
